title: Wonderful tour!
text:
This was an amazing tour! The tour guide was extremely knowledgeable.

The highlight of the tour was seeing the Tomb of  Christopher Columbus.

The guide knew the best stops for pictures.

Guide met us at our hotel and walked with us to the sites.
author: David_A

title: Enrique was very...
text: Enrique was very personable, friendly and welcoming when we met up for the tour. His knowledge of Sevilla, Spanish and world history provided a wonderful learning experience. We not only appreciated the beauty and wonder of the sites, but we also gained new perspective of the rich traditions of Sevilla and Spain.
author: Julie_H

title: Would do it again
text: Wonderful knowledge of everything Sevilla and very accommodating to my own specific requests and questions.
author: Andrew_P

title: This was an excellent...
text: This was an excellent tour! Our guide, Sara, was very knowledgeable and friendly. We learned a lot, and it was great to get the private tour experience of the alcazar and cathedral. We had a wonderful time!
author: Donald_C

title: Seville Splendor
text: We had a wonderful time in beautiful Seville. Everything is within walking distance and it has so much to offer. Rafa was a fabulous guide. He is extremely knowledgeable about the subject matter and very flexible. He’s very kind, easy going and has a good sense of humor. Also, he was very helpful in offering restaurant options.
author: Sharon_D

title: Excellent tour of Seville attractions
text: Sara is an excellent tour guide.  She is so knowledgeable and friendly.  She engaged well with all of us including our teenage kids.  It was easy to understand Sara.
author: emily_s

title: A great day touring the sights of Seville
text: We were professionally communicated with by the company prior to our tour. On tour day, we were met by Alejandro, our guide for the day. Unfortunately, they were having a big event at the cathedral, and were unable to take our tour there. But instead, Alejandro took us around the old barrio, and to the Plaza before taking us through the Real Alcazar. He was very knowledgeable about the history of what we were seeing, and had such a great personality. He made our tour so special. I highly recommend using this company for touring Seville!
author: Scott_N

title: Amazing palace and cathedral tour
text: We loved our tour with Sara.  We had three young kids and four adults and toured the palace and cathedral.  Sara was incredibly well informed and easy going, and was great at adapting to the dynamic.  She also had tickets.  A lot of people offering tours with skip the line tickets cancelled as they did not have tickets.  Sara did, and we were happy to pay more for her reliability and fluency in English.  We highly recommend her to anyone!
author: Anthon_E

title: Must see places in Seville.
text: Our tour guide, Rafia, did a great job explaining the history of the places we visited.  He was very knowledgeable.
author: James_H

title: Great Tour!
text: Rafa is an amazing tour guide and very knowledgeable.  He is well versed in English and knows his history!  I would recommend this tour!
author: lliana_B
